statement: 材质权威采用证据校准后的商业级硅溶胶精密铸造不锈钢视觉：以金属度、粗糙度、各向异性、清洁微表面和受控反射环境形成工业摄影质感；不通过白色漫反射、脏污噪声、战损划痕或黑色 WCB 观感伪造高级感。

appearance_state.body_surface_style: commercial mid-grey fine satin stainless lifted by white-studio reflection
appearance_state.flange_surface_style: clean machined stainless with broad satin reflection
appearance_state.ball_material_style: clean polished stainless ball with soft-studio reflection gradient
appearance_state.commercial_finish_grade: refined industrial product photography, not used-part realism

pbr_calibration_policy.lighting_environment_dependency: commercial stainless brightness must be reviewed under the active white-studio reflection authority before changing material substrate values

lightness_policy.principle: white-studio brightness must come from metal reflection and environment, not from pushing stainless base color to white diffuse

cast-satin-body.purpose: dominant pressure shell and cast body surfaces

machined-flange-faces.purpose: flat flanges, machined rings and catalogue-facing cut faces
machined-flange-faces.texture_band: controlled machining direction without dirty rings

brushed-side-faces.purpose: secondary satin side faces and flange side walls
brushed-side-faces.texture_band: clean satin brush, not scratch damage

edge-burnish.purpose: small bevel highlights that separate industrial edges
edge-burnish.coverage_policy: thin edge highlight only; never a broad white body material

machined-bores-and-root-shadows.purpose: inner bores, bolt bores and root grooves that preserve depth hierarchy
machined-bores-and-root-shadows.edge_policy: darkened by geometry and reflection hierarchy, not by dirty blotches

fastener-stainless.purpose: studs, nuts, washers and small stainless hardware

polished-stainless-ball.reflection_policy: broad white and soft silver gradients only; no readable equipment, black flags, hard panel shapes or surrounding non-ball product parts

graphite-packing.purpose: graphite packing and dark seal hierarchy
graphite-packing.texture_policy: fine matte sheen only, not dirty grease

rubber-seal.purpose: black rubber seal where distinct from graphite packing

soft-seal-ptfe.purpose: warm off-white or pale grey soft-seat material
soft-seal-ptfe.whiteness_policy: warm technical polymer, not pure white plastic

allowed_surface_texture.body: fine clean satin casting texture with low-amplitude micro variation only
allowed_surface_texture.machined_faces: controlled machining direction without visible dirty rings or dirty radial bands
allowed_surface_texture.ball: smooth polished metal with clean reflection gradients
allowed_surface_texture.fasteners: clean stainless hierarchy, lower visual priority than body and ball
allowed_surface_texture.dark_seals: graphite or rubber hierarchy with fine matte sheen only
allowed_surface_texture.soft_seats: warm off-white or pale grey PTFE-style polymer, never pure white plastic

commercial_surface_integrity.clean_micro_surface_policy: micro variation may break perfect CG smoothness, but must remain below the threshold where it reads as dirt, corrosion, stains, scratches or war damage
commercial_surface_integrity.body_shell_rule: dominant cast-satin body shell must read as one continuous commercial stainless surface; secondary machining, bore, seal and hardware roles may exist only where real part boundaries support them
commercial_surface_integrity.audit_expectation: runtime manifests must declare whether non-runtime material sources, polygon-zone artifacts, product-facing material hard edges and dirty-blotch highlights are present

forbidden: WCB interpretation
cast carbon steel look
black cast steel look
white diffuse shortcut on stainless body
pure white plastic body look
chalky powder-coated stainless look
heavy bead-blasted commercial release body
war-damaged look
dirty scratch proof
explicit scratch geometry in approved runtime
dirty blotch procedural color noise in approved runtime
cast_noise texture in approved release material path
cloudy color variation presented as commercial finish
roughness noise that reads as dirt
broad edge-burnish material replacing the cast body material
polished ball roughness high enough to kill commercial studio reflection
visible polygon material-zone triangles on product-facing stainless body
hard material-zone seams on curved body shell
dirty white blotch highlights that read as stain or light gear
non-runtime material experiment treated as current hero render authority
